news.headline: Wall Street rallies: S&P 500 +1.58%, Nasdaq +1.44%
news.what_happened: US equities closed strongly higher; US 10Y yield eased to 4.89% (-1.2%) and the dollar index slipped 0.24%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-on global cue and softer yields/dollar support FII flows into Indian large caps. Nifty already closed 23,960.6 (+2.2%) so part of the gain may be priced in.

news.headline: Crude eases: WTI -1.0%, Brent -0.6%
news.what_happened: WTI at $87.21 and Brent at $94.04, both lower on the day but still elevated in absolute terms.
news.why_it_matters: Mild relief for fuel-sensitive sectors (airlines, paints); small negative for upstream oil.

news.headline: Hang Seng +2.9%, Gold +1.5%
news.what_happened: Hong Kong surged 2.9% while gold rose 1.5% to $4,136/oz; Nikkei -0.3%.
news.why_it_matters: Strong China-linked sentiment supports metals; gold strength is a tailwind for gold-loan NBFCs.

sector_outlook.reason: Nasdaq +1.4% but rupee flat; sector weight 0.76x

picks.logic: Jet fuel is a large share of IndiGo opex; softer crude is a direct cost tailwind. Modest target given Nifty already rallied 2.2%.
Crude derivatives are a major raw-material input for paints; lower crude eases margin pressure.

risks: Thursday is weekly options expiry - elevated volatility, avoid aggressive entries at open
